brand_identity.name: THE WEDDING CARS
brand_identity.tagline: More than a wedding car. It's part of your story.
brand_identity.commercial_headline: YOUR WEDDING DESERVES A BEAUTIFUL ARRIVAL.
brand_identity.supporting_indonesian: Karena di hari spesial, setiap detail punya cerita.
brand_identity.archetype: Luxury Editorial + Premium Automotive + Trustworthy Local Wedding Specialist

headline_serif.usage: Main editorial headlines, section titles, quote callouts, hero titles

body_sans.usage: Navigation, body paragraphs, button text, feature specs, form labels, badges

accent_italic.usage: Indonesian supporting subtext, romantic editorial captions, testimonial quotes

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-neutral-900 leading-[1.15]
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif text-neutral-900 tracking-tight leading-snug
hierarchy_rules.eyebrow_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-medium text-amber-900/70 font-sans mb-3 block
hierarchy_rules.subtext_quote: text-base sm:text-lg italic font-serif text-neutral-600 leading-relaxed

visual_enhancers.editorial_borders: 1px solid #E5DFD5 with delicate 0.5px champagne gold accent highlights on hover
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border border-stone-200/60 for sticky header and mobile sticky CTA bar
visual_enhancers.image_overlays: Max opacity bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/20 to-transparent for hero overlays so real photography shines through
visual_enhancers.card_radii: rounded-none or rounded-sm for timeless luxury editorial aesthetic (NO aggressive rounded-3xl or cartoonish radii)

grids_and_layouts.generous_spacing: py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32 for major homepage sections to create breathability
grids_and_layouts.bento_fleet_grid: Grid featuring BMW 5 Series in dominant col-span-full md:col-span-8 spotlight card with starting price Rp1.999.000, flanked by supporting fleet items
grids_and_layouts.editorial_story_blocks: 60/40 split layouts combining large photography with editorial storytelling copy and subtle thin line dividers
grids_and_layouts.real_weddings_masonry: 12-photo editorial masonry grid with hover captions and lightbox photo expansion
grids_and_layouts.sticky_mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports (<768px) with quick call/chat CTA: 'CHECK AVAILABILITY' pointing to WhatsApp
grids_and_layouts.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right floating WhatsApp button with ping animation and pre-filled inquiry text ('Halo The Wedding Cars, saya ingin cek ketersediaan mobil untuk tanggal...')

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in public/index.html or src/index.css.
Implement bilingual layout: prominent English luxury editorial titles paired with warm Indonesian supporting body and descriptive copy.
Ensure BMW 5 Series starting at Rp1.999.000 is highlighted as the primary Hero Product with an interactive gallery.
Include a date & location availability checking widget connected to WhatsApp pre-filled messaging.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, links) MUST include data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or high contrast SaaS templates. Use Warm White #FAFAF7, Ivory #F4F0EA, Charcoal #1A1A1A, and subtle Champagne Gold #C5A880.
Ensure mobile bottom sticky bar and floating WhatsApp button are responsive, non-intrusive, and always visible.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use explicit CSS transitions for opacity and colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Design mobile layouts with high clarity, touch targets of at least 44px, and sticky conversion bars.
